The depot was Southgate. I've posted that as a reply to Tobias's message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api.

I found it in that same channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka said label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. She closed the incident at 18:43 that day, once labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.
